        15       Number 1856, legislative resolution

        16       memorializing Governor David A. Paterson to

        17       proclaim May 11-17, 2009, as Fibromyalgia

        18       Awareness Week in the State of New York.

        19                  ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:

        20       Senator Little, on the resolution.

        21                  SENATOR LITTLE:    Thank you,

        22       Mr. President.

        23                  Once again, the Legislature is

        24       proclaiming a week for fibromyalgia awareness.



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4389



         1       And the key word here is "awareness."  Because

         2       fibromyalgia affects many, many people in this

         3       state and in this country.  It affects men,

         4       women and children, although it mainly affects

         5       women.

         6                  And it's more than a disease, it's

         7       actually a syndrome that has no known cause

         8       and no known cure.  It's a syndrome that has

         9       extreme fatigue, chronic joint pain, and a

        10       real debilitating ability to lead a normal

        11       life.

        12                  I have a friend that has

        13       fibromyalgia, and she described to me waking

        14       up in the morning and feeling as though she

        15       had the dentist's lead shield over her, and

        16       the inability to actually be able to get out

        17       of bed and to function that day.

        18                  Because we have paid some attention

        19       to fibromyalgia, we are looking at ways to

        20       make their life easier.  There are now some

        21       drugs that are available.  But for many, many

        22       women, the main way of curing this is through

        23       some other forms:  through dietary, through

        24       acupuncture -- my friend goes acupuncture once



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         4390



         1       a month -- through massage, through altering

         2       your life so that you can function through

         3       this syndrome and this real, real debilitating

         4       disease.

         5                  Another friend who's a physician

         6       said this is one of the worst diagnoses that

         7       you can give to a woman, because you can't

         8       really tell them how they got it and you can't

         9       tell them that they will be cured from this.

        10       It's something that a person has to learn to

        11       live with.

        12                  So the more we make people aware of

        13       this fibromyalgia and how it affects people

        14       and how it can be controlled, the better off

        15       we will be.  Many, many people go through two

        16       to three years of medical visits before

        17       they're even diagnosed with this, so awareness

        18       is key.

        19                  And I thank all of you for joining

        20       me in this resolution.  And I know that anyone

        21       who wishes to join the resolution certainly is

        22       welcome to, and we appreciate your

        23       participation.

        24                  And thank you to the many people

        12                  THE SECRETARY:    "WHEREAS, An

        13       estimated 10 million people in the United

        14       States, 6 to 8 percent of the population, and

        15       millions of people worldwide have been

        16       diagnosed with fibromyalgia, a disease for

        17       which there is no known cause or cure; and

        18                  "WHEREAS, A chronic disorder that

        19       increases at alarming rates, fibromyalgia

        20       causes fatigue and debilitating pain in women,

        21       men, and children of all ethnicities; and

        22                  "WHEREAS, Patients with

        23       fibromyalgia often have to learn to live with

        24       widespread pain throughout their bodies,

         1       extreme fatigue, sleep disorders, stiffness

         2       and weakness, migraine headaches, numbness and

         3       tingling, and impairment of memory and

         4       concentration; and

         5                  "WHEREAS, It often takes an average

         6       of five years to receive a diagnosis of

         7       fibromyalgia, and medical professionals

         8       frequently are inadequately educated on the

         9       diagnosis and treatment of fibromyalgia; and

        10                  "WHEREAS, Increased awareness and

        11       expanded knowledge of the realities of life

        12       with fibromyalgia will allow the community at

        13       large to better support people who struggle

        14       with the challenges of this chronic pain

        15       disorder; and
